title: Field-pair Coherence Regression Hunter
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Our current structured-output monitors focus primarily on top-level JSON shape (presence/typing) and field-level distributional shifts. These miss a large class of regressions where individual fields remain valid but internal coherence between related fields (e.g., start_time/end_time, currency/amount, address.country/postal_code format, status/code pairs) diverges after a model or configuration change. Such incoherence can be subtle, affect downstream processors, and silently erode product quality.

Goal: Build a pipeline that detects regression-level changes in field-pair and small-tuple coherence tied to model/config rollouts. The system should: capture both semantic and syntactic coherence rules, surface signal correlated with a specific model config diff or rollout step, and integrate with console alerting + canary/rollout gates. It must have low false positive rate for production alerts and provide actionable debug context (examples, diffs, probable root cause).

Scope: This ticket implements the detection and alerting prototype:
- Define a catalog of field-pair and tuple patterns (auto-discovered and curated).
- Instrument evals to compute cohort-level coherence scores and sample-level anomaly markers.
- Correlate score deltas with deploy metadata (model id, config hash, quantization profile, routing policy).
- Surface signals in Console and generate recommended triage (revert, canary extension, targeted retrain).

Non-goals: This ticket does not fully productionize long-term storage or UI polish for the Console. It focuses on the detection model, telemetry hooks, example payloads, and an alerting runbook for on-call teams.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Implement a modular coherence-scoring library that accepts model responses and produces per-sample coherence markers and a cohort-level score (0-100).
A2: Instrument the eval harness to run the coherence checks on shadow/canary traffic and historical baseline samples, producing delta reports per-deploy commit SHA.

A3: Correlate a 95th-percentile cohort coherence delta > 8 points with a Git commit / model-config diff and emit an alert payload containing 10 representative failing samples and the top 3 likely root causes.
A4: Integrate alerting hook with Console alert API and append a basic remediation suggestion (rollback / narrow canary) to the alert body.
A5: Provide a short runbook (triage checklist) linked in the alert and visible in the ticket comments.
comments: 2026-02-11 Marcus Li: Spike completed — implemented a toy coherence scorer for time-interval pairs using conditional probability of end_time > start_time. False positives concentrated on timezone-normalization edge cases.

2026-02-12 Aisha Patel: Reviewed spike notes. Decide to include both rule-based validators (regex, monotonicity, enums) and a lightweight learned co-occurrence model for fuzzy pairs (e.g., currency-symbol + locale-specific formatting).
2026-02-14 Marcus Li: Added telemetry schema. Cohort score computed as weighted sum of per-pattern violation rates with exponential smoothing over 1h/24h. Will instrument canary endpoint next.

2026-02-18 QA Team (Leah Kim): Ran the prototype on last 7 days of production shadow traffic — found a 12-point coherence drop after runtime-1.21 deploy (model-id m-open-xx). Attached representative samples.
monitoring_query: SELECT deploy_sha, cohort, pctile_95(coherence_score) as p95 FROM coherence_events WHERE env='canary' AND window='1h' GROUP BY deploy_sha, cohort ORDER BY deploy_sha DESC LIMIT 50
runbook: Triage steps: (1) Inspect the alert payload and 10 failing samples. (2) Check deploy metadata for model_id/config_hash. (3) Re-run coherence checks on historical baseline for the same cohort. (4) If delta confirmed, extend canary or rollback to previous commit; add a task to add targeted evals for failing patterns.
